info.title: Commercial Banking — Treasury Services API
info.description: SVC-007 (Treasury Services) API surface within CAP-002 (Commercial Banking). CAP-002.04 promoted sub-capability. Exposes endpoints for FX spot trade enquiry, price quotation, trade execution, and settlement management. This API contract covers the SVC-007 Treasury Services capability — namespaced under the commercial banking API gateway (SVC-101) at /commercial/v1/treasury/. All endpoints require Bearer JWT issued by SVC-100 (IAM) with scope commercial.treasury. Internal dealer endpoints additionally require scope commercial.treasury.dealer. Cross-capability integrations (CAP-005 sanctions screening, CAP-003 nostro settlement) are exclusively async events via SVC-102 — those capability boundaries are NOT exposed as API endpoints in this contract.

post.summary: Submit an FX spot trade enquiry and receive an indicative rate
post.description: PH-059: Creates an FXTrade entity (ENT-040) with status = enquiry. Validates that the BusinessCustomer is active via same-capability call to SVC-005 (GET /business-customers/{id}). Fetches current indicative rate from Bloomberg FXGO rate feed. Returns the indicative all-in rate with a disclaimer that it is NOT a firm price. Publishes EVT-083 (FXQuoteRequested). The trade_id returned should be used for all subsequent quote and execution requests.

201.description: FX trade enquiry created. Indicative rate returned — not a firm price.

example.rate_valid_disclaimer: Indicative rate only — not a firm price. Request a firm quote to lock in a rate.

400.description: Invalid request — missing required fields, unsupported currency pair, or invalid value_date (e.g. weekend, bank holiday).

403.description: Client not authorised for FX trading — FX master agreement not on file or BusinessCustomer.status != active.

503.description: Bloomberg FXGO rate feed unavailable or stale (> 250ms threshold). EXC-003: Retry after rate feed restores.

get.summary: Retrieve the current state of an FX trade
get.description: Returns the full FXTrade entity (ENT-040) for the given trade_id including current status, executed rate, value_date, confirmation status, and MiFIR transaction reference. Available to PER-003 (client), PER-053 (dealer), and Treasury Operations.

post.summary: Request a firm FX spot quote for an existing trade enquiry
post.description: PH-060: Generates a firm FX spot quote for the trade_id created in PH-059. Fetches current live rate from Bloomberg FXGO, applies approved mark-up for the client tier, and creates an FXQuote entity (ENT-041) with status = quoted and valid_until = now + 30 seconds. Publishes EVT-084 (FXQuoteProvided). The firm_rate in the response is the legally binding rate at which the bank will transact if the client accepts within valid_until. The rate is not guaranteed beyond valid_until — a new quote must be requested.

201.description: Firm FX quote created. Rate is binding for 30 seconds.

404.description: Trade not found or not in enquiry status

409.description: An active unexpired quote already exists for this trade_id. Either accept the existing quote or wait for it to expire.

post.summary: Accept the current firm quote and book the FX trade
post.description: PH-061: Client or dealer accepts the firm quote for trade_id. SVC-007 validates the referenced quote_id has status = quoted and valid_until > now (server-side clock check). Calls SVC-005 (same-capability) to verify sell-currency account balance is sufficient. On validation success: transitions FXQuote.status = accepted, calculates buy_amount, sets FXTrade.status = booked and dealt_at. Publishes EVT-085 (FXTradeExecuted) and EVT-089 (FXCounterpartySanctionsScreened). Returns the booked trade confirmation including trade_id, executed rate, buy/sell amounts, and value_date. IDEMPOTENT on quote_id — duplicate requests return 200 with the existing booked state.

200.description: FX trade booked. Idempotent response if already booked.

example.confirmation_message: Trade booked. Confirmation will be sent via SWIFT MT300 shortly.

400.description: Invalid request — quote_id missing or does not match trade_id

409.description: Quote expired (valid_until exceeded) or already accepted/rejected. A new quote must be requested.

422.description: Insufficient account balance in sell_currency — trade cannot be booked

get.summary: List all quotes for a given FX trade
get.description: Returns all FXQuote records (ENT-041) associated with the trade_id, ordered by quoted_at descending. Useful for audit and re-quote history review.

200.description: List of quotes for the trade

get.summary: Retrieve the settlement record for an FX trade
get.description: PH-063: Returns the FXSettlement entity (ENT-042) for the given trade_id. Available from PH-063 onwards. Includes settlement_status, nostro accounts, settled_at, and swift_settlement_ref.

404.description: Settlement not yet created (trade not yet at PH-063) or trade not found

post.summary: MLRO: Release a sanctions hold on an FX trade settlement
post.description: EXC-001 resolution: Allows the MLRO (PER-058) to release a sanctions hold on FXSettlement.settlement_status = sanctions_hold after completing their review. Requires scope commercial.treasury.mlro. MLRO must provide resolution type (false_positive | permitted_transaction), an OFSI reference number if applicable, and a written rationale. The resolution and MLRO identity are recorded immutably on the FXTrade audit trail. On release: FXSettlement.settlement_status transitions to initiated and EVT-087 (FXSettlementInitiated) is published to resume the settlement flow.

example.rationale: Name collision with OFSI listed entity. Verification confirms different legal entity via Companies House registration CH-05491021. OFSI confirmed no listing for this entity.

200.description: Sanctions hold released. Settlement will proceed via CAP-003 event flow.

404.description: Trade not found or not in sanctions_hold status

BearerAuth.description: Bearer JWT issued by SVC-100 (IAM). Required scopes: commercial.treasury (all endpoints). Additional: commercial.treasury.dealer (quote generation with spread override). commercial.treasury.mlro (sanctions release).

client_id.description: BusinessCustomer.business_customer_id (ENT-B001). Must reference an active BusinessCustomer.

sell_currency.description: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code for the currency the client is selling.

buy_currency.description: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code for the currency the client is buying. Must differ from sell_currency.

sell_amount.description: Notional amount in sell_currency. Positive decimal, max 2 dp.

value_date.description: Requested settlement date. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be a valid spot date (T+2 business days from today, excluding weekends and relevant bank holidays).

dealer_id.description: Optional. Staff.staff_id of PER-053. Required for phone-dealt trades. If absent, assumed portal self-serve by PER-003.

confirm_indicative.description: Client/dealer confirmation that they have seen the indicative rate and wish to proceed to a firm quote.

spread_override_bps.description: Optional. Dealer-only (requires commercial.treasury.dealer scope). Override the default spread in basis points for relationship pricing. Must be within the dealer's delegated authority limits.

mifir_disclosure.description: MiFIR Article 27 best execution disclosure embedded in quote response

quote_id.description: FXQuote.quote_id from PH-060. Must be status=quoted and valid_until > now.

client_confirmation.description: Must be true. Explicit acceptance of the firm quote terms. For portal trades: client clicks 'Accept Trade'. For phone-dealt trades: PER-053 enters on behalf of verbal client confirmation (call recording active).

sell_account_id.description: BusinessAccount.business_account_id for the sell-currency debit leg.

buy_account_id.description: BusinessAccount.business_account_id for the buy-currency credit leg.

call_recording_ref.description: Conditional. Required for phone-dealt trades. Reference to COBS 11.2A call recording. Format: CALL-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.

buy_leg_nostro.description: SWIFT BIC of buy-currency nostro account

sell_leg_nostro.description: SWIFT BIC of sell-currency nostro account

mlro_id.description: Staff.staff_id of the MLRO (PER-058). Must hold commercial.treasury.mlro scope.

resolution.description: false_positive: the screening match was not a true sanctions hit. permitted_transaction: OFSI licence or general licence applies.

ofsi_reference.description: Conditional. OFSI confirmation reference if applicable.

rationale.description: Written rationale for release. Minimum 50 characters. Recorded immutably on FXTrade audit trail.

reviewed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the MLRO completed their review.

message.example: Sanctions hold released. Settlement initiated via CAP-003 event flow.

trace_id.description: Distributed trace ID for support correlation
